# VS Code Tools Improvement Prompts

These starter prompts are designed to automatically test, improve, and update the `.github/chatmodes/SUNNO/tools.md` and related tool selection in chatmode files. The goal is to perfect the tools by iteratively testing and refining their usage in VS Code.

---


## Self-Improving Starter Prompts for Tool Testing & Enhancement

### 1. Tool Functionality & Auto-Fix
- "Test all tools defined in .github/chatmodes/SUNNO/tools.md for expected input/output. For any errors or failures, automatically apply fixes to .github/chatmodes/SUNNO/tools.md and retest until all tools work as intended. Log each fix and result."

### 2. Tool Usage Optimization & Correction
- "Analyze tool usage in chatmode.md files. If inefficiencies or errors are found, automatically update tool selection and invocation patterns, then retest workflows until optimal results are achieved."

### 3. Automated Documentation & Example Update
- "After tool tests, update .github/chatmodes/SUNNO/tools.md with new examples, error handling notes, and best practices based on test results and applied fixes. Repeat until documentation reflects only working, validated tools."

### 4. Tool Selection Enhancement & Validation
- "Review chatmode.md files for tool selection logic. If better tools or patterns are found, update the files and validate by running workflow tests. Continue until the most effective tools are selected."

### 5. Regression Testing & Auto-Revert
- "Run regression tests on all tools after any update to .github/chatmodes/SUNNO/tools.md or chatmode.md. If breaking changes are detected, automatically revert or fix and retest until stability is restored."

### 6. Persistent Improvement Loop
- "Continuously run automated tests and improvements for all tools and workflows. Never stop until all tools are fully functional and optimized for VS Code. Log all changes and results."

---


## Workflow
1. Use these prompts to initiate automated, self-improving tool testing and enhancement cycles.
2. Log all test results, fixes, and changes.
3. Automatically apply updates to .github/chatmodes/SUNNO/tools.md and chatmode.md files after each successful fix or improvement.
4. Retest after every change; repeat until all tools and workflows are fully functional and optimized for VS Code.

---


## Example Automation Prompt
- "Run all self-improving starter prompts in this file. For every failure, automatically apply fixes and retest until all tools and workflows are working perfectly. Log all changes, fixes, and test results."
